Well now, isn’t [VAR 0101(0001)] just a sweetheart!\c
And yes, I heard the news from young Leon.
I’m glad someone bothered to tell me!
Off to Wedgehurst, aren’t you?[VAR 0114(0008)]

Here we are!
A bit of pocket money for your journey.\c
Buy yourself a little something at the Pokémon
Center. Maybe some Potions or something![VAR 0114(0008)]
Remember that [VAR 0101(0001)] will battle to\nthe very end for you...\c\nSo don’t you go pushing the poor dear too hard![VAR 0114(0008)]
Come home to rest anytime that you need.\nAfter all...east or west, home is best.[VAR 0114(0008)]
